name: Shape Wipe Transition
description: From a button, an accent disc floods the frame with the next scene riding 80ms behind it; the dark scene's headline and chips land, then a close button wipes it back the same way. Both scenes counter-scale for parallax.
move: From a button, an accent disc floods the frame with the next scene riding 80ms behind it; the dark scene's headline and chips land, then a close button wipes it back the same way. Both scenes counter-scale for parallax.
how: Deterministic draw(t). Forward: clip-path circles from the button (accent lead, then scene B). Return: radial-gradient masks open holes from the close button. Radii follow Flow quart in-out over 1.1s (chosen for a lower top speed than expo so the edge does not strobe). Outgoing scene scales to 0.95, incoming settles from 1.08.
adapt: Swap scene A/B content; FROM and CLOSE_AT are the wipe origins. Placeholder copy is generic. Colours come from the palette tokens at the top of the page (--bg, --surface, --ink, --muted, --accent, --accent-2); change those to re-brand it.
port: Pure draw(t): mount the markup in the shot and call draw from the film's frame hook with shot-local time; wait for fonts before measuring.
caveats: Original implementation of the "Shape-layer transition" motion-design idea; no third-party preset, kit or brand assets.
Starts and ends on its opening frame so it loops; trim the exit when cutting to the next shot.
